description.en: Original interpretive negative Asteriacites-inspired resting impression in one continuous sediment slab: shallow central body recess and five spreading tapering arm traces with real gray-readable depth. No black star decal, living sea-star mesh, exact excavated specimen or identified producer species. Negative-impression polarity deliberately retained from the frozen brief.
